text:
emily.g: quick idea — tired of ad-hoc flips between fp8/int8/4bit mid-request. thinking of a tiny 'switch matrix' evaluated once per request + a lock window. want quick sanity checks.

raj.k: sounds useful. what signals are you feeding it? just latency or quality too?

emily.g: both. start small: degradation_score (0-1), token_zone (head|mid|tail), kv_cache_hit (bool), model_capabilities (set), customer_override. output: ordered allowed_bitpaths + row_tag.

taylor: show an example row so i can picture behavior.

emily.g: example rows: 

```
row: low_tail_cached
when ds <= 0.03 and token_zone == tail and kv_cache_hit == true
allow: [fp8, int8]
lock_window: 64
reason: low-risk tail + cached KV
```

```
row: conservative_fp8
when ds <= 0.06 and model_capabilities includes fp8
allow: [fp8]
lock_window: 32
```

```
row: default_safe
allow: [fp32]
```

morgan: add an estimated_risk_score per-row so we can pick top-safe path and show it in telemetry.

ops-bot: telemetry reminder — low cardinality only. use short hashed row ids and sample full contexts ~0.5%.

hana-bot: telemetry suggestion: attach sw.row=sha1(row), sw.inputs=(ds,zone,kv_hit) sw.allowed and sw.risk_bucket. include trace_id when sampled.

raj.k: runtime compatibility concern: some fused kernels can't run fp8/4bit. how do we fail?

emily.g: runtime resolves model_adapter.supported_paths(model_id) first and intersects with matrix.allow. if intersection empty -> fallback_kind = higher_fidelity_variant OR non-quant slow path. tag decision with fallback_kind.

taylor: oscillation history still bugs me. last time we toggled on punctuation and produced artifacts.

emily.g: mitigations: lock_window prevents token-by-token swaps; require change only at sentence boundary or when quality_stability(window) < threshold; also enforce max one change per-request.

morgan: rollout plan? shadow first?

emily.g: yes — shadow for 14 days at 3-5% traffic. compute paired deltas per cohort (intent, customer). metrics: exact_match_delta, nll_delta, hallucination_proxy. auto-disable cohort if thresholds breached.

raj.k: thresholds? define something operational.

emily.g: propose: exact-match drop > 0.5% absolute OR hallucination_proxy increase > 0.25% absolute => pause matrix for that cohort and page. tune after data.

ops-bot: add circuit-breaker: if latency_p99 on quant path > 1.1x baseline for 5m, pause and roll to safe path.

hana-bot: include kv_cache_miss_rate in decision telemetry; misses correlate with quality drops.

taylor: runtime API ask: GET /v1/bitpath?inputs=... should return {row_hash, allowed_paths, risk_score, lock_window, explain_tag}. small human explain tag helps debug.

morgan: config precedence: customer_pin > endpoint_flag > matrix_default. keep overrides in control-plane; runtime receives final allowed_paths.

emily.g: sampling for repro: store prompt_hash, model_version, deterministic_seed, kv_prefix_hash when sampled. ops will redact PII. keep full context sampling <= 0.5%.

raj.k: i'll produce a capability matrix for adapters (which fused ops support which bitpaths). expecting quirks for matmul fusions and custom CUDA kernels.

emily.g: thanks — next step i'll draft a short RFC with: 1) matrix grammar, 2) runtime contract + adapter query, 3) telemetry fields + sampling plan, 4) rollout/shadowing plan, 5) ops playbook (circuit-breakers + pausing).

taylor: i'll own rollout runbook and alerts. morgan, ops-bot — want to review ops thresholds.

morgan: will do. also add a tiny log line for oncall: "bitpath.row=<hash> chosen=". keeps debugging quick.

emily.g: will include. ping me if you want to co-author. tagging @raj.k @taylor. :thumbsup:
